title: Remove the infallible Result from non-Windows check_directory in task-sync readers
outcome: Remove the infallible Result from non-Windows check_directory in task-sync readers
acceptance: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings passes on master's source for both x86_64-pc-windows-msvc and a Linux build (WSL), with no #[allow] and no vacuous check added to satisfy the lint.

Both check_directory helpers (src/task_sync/progress/prepared/files.rs and src/bin_support/task_sync/setup/files.rs) keep their Windows reparse-point refusal unchanged, and existing task-sync tests pass.

completion.summary: Both directory-check helpers and all six callers compile only on Windows, removing the infallible non-Windows Result without changing Windows reparse refusal. Final full Windows gate and WSL Clippy pass on the reviewed input; Codex and Claude reviews clean, independent acceptance 2 of 2 passed with unchanged criteria. Landed, installed and pushed; four live stores ready. Separate pre-existing WSL preparation failure remains tracked independently.
